# Pull request

## Change

Describe the addition, correction, or removal and its WordPress use case.

## Source evidence

- Primary source:
- Maintainer and resource type:
- Source checked on:
- Documentation review or hands-on test:
- Requirements, beta status, or limitations:

## Checklist

- [ ] The description is supported by the primary source.
- [ ] The English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese editions match.
- [ ] Source links and local navigation work.
- [ ] Migration or research notes are updated if needed.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Markdown, link, and Agent Skill source checks pass.
